obligations.source_text: 통제된 나른한 움직임 — 시작점과 미완 목적지, 안정된 지지 경로, 깨어 있는 목표 시선, 같은 방향의 직물 지연을 한 프레임에 보여주는 성인 패션 에디토리얼

bindings.unfinished_motion_phrase: The start position and unfinished destination remain visible between the open specimen drawer and the ribbon knot in the same frame.
bindings.stable_support_phrase: One planted foot preserves controlled balance, with coherent hip, knee, and ankle joint continuity.
bindings.alert_attention_phrase: Awake eyes remain tied to the chosen destination at the ribbon knot and follow the controlled hand trajectory.
bindings.motion_lag_phrase: The satin fabric trails the same movement direction as the loose hair strand, reaching hand, and calibration ribbon along the clockwise arc.
